argv:
import gzip,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
helper=Path('/home/ray/developer/ai/math/audits/2026-10-07-m3-fresh-checkout/check_lean_axioms.py')
historical=Path('/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447/artifacts/c5_integrate_branch_review/logs/lean_axioms.log.gz')
source=Path('/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447/Math/ExcessTwoCertificatesAudit.lean')
control_root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='math-m3-axiom-helper-controls-'))
text=gzip.decompress(historical.read_bytes()).decode()
pattern=re.compile(r"^'([^']+)' (?:depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)",re.MULTILINE)
matches=list(pattern.finditer(text))
assert len(matches)==558
controls={'historical_baseline':text,'missing_first_declaration':text[matches[0].end():].lstrip('\n'),'duplicate_first_declaration':text+'\n'+matches[0].group(0)+'\n','sorry_axon_first_declaration':text.replace('Quot.sound','sorryAx',1),'extra_error_diagnostic':text+'\nMath/ExcessTwoCertificatesAudit.lean:1:0: error: helper control diagnostic\n'}
first_positive=next(m for m in matches if m.group(1).endswith('_positive'))
old=first_positive.group(0)
controls['positive_native_injected']=text[:first_positive.start()]+old[:-1]+', foreign.native_decide.ax_1]'+text[first_positive.end():]
first_rejected=next(m for m in matches if m.group(1).endswith('_rejected'))
old=first_rejected.group(0)
mutated=re.sub(r'\b[^,\s\[\]]*\.native_decide\.[^,\s\[\]]*','foreign.native_decide.ax_1',old)
assert mutated!=old
controls['rejected_foreign_native_replaced']=text[:first_rejected.start()]+mutated+text[first_rejected.end():]
records={}
for name,value in controls.items():
    log=control_root/(name+'.log')
    log.write_text(value)
    output=control_root/(name+'.json')
    run=subprocess.run(['python3',str(helper),'--log',str(log),'--source',str(source),'--output',str(output)],text=True,capture_output=True)
    (control_root/(name+'.stdout')).write_text(run.stdout)
    (control_root/(name+'.stderr')).write_text(run.stderr)
    records[name]={'exit_code':run.returncode,'last_stderr_line':run.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if run.stderr else '', 'output_exists':output.exists()}
assert records['historical_baseline']['exit_code']==0
assert all(records[k]['exit_code']!=0 for k in ('missing_first_declaration','duplicate_first_declaration','sorry_axon_first_declaration','positive_native_injected'))
baseline=json.loads((control_root/'historical_baseline.json').read_text())
print(json.dumps({'scope':'HELPER CONTROLS ONLY: historical Oct05 log and synthetic corruptions; not current LC build or axioms evidence','control_root':str(control_root),'helper_sha256':hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'historical_gzip_sha256':hashlib.sha256(historical.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'baseline_groups':baseline['groups'],'baseline_declaration_count':baseline['declaration_count'],'controls':records},sort_keys=True))

import gzip,hashlib,json,re,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
audit=Path('/home/ray/developer/ai/math/audits/2026-10-07-m3-fresh-checkout')
helper=audit/'check_lean_axioms.py'
historical=Path('/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447/artifacts/c5_integrate_branch_review/logs/lean_axioms.log.gz')
source=Path('/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447/Math/ExcessTwoCertificatesAudit.lean')
helper_sha=hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
control_root=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='math-m3-axiom-helper-controls-v3-'))
text=gzip.decompress(historical.read_bytes()).decode()
pattern=re.compile(r"^'([^']+)' (?:depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)",re.MULTILINE)
matches=list(pattern.finditer(text))
assert len(matches)==558
controls={'historical_baseline':text,'missing_first_declaration':text[matches[0].end():].lstrip('\n'),'duplicate_first_declaration':text+'\n'+matches[0].group(0)+'\n','sorry_axon_first_declaration':text.replace('Quot.sound','sorryAx',1),'extra_error_diagnostic':text+'\nMath/ExcessTwoCertificatesAudit.lean:1:0: error: helper control diagnostic\n'}
first_positive=next(m for m in matches if m.group(1).endswith('_positive'))
old=first_positive.group(0)
controls['positive_native_injected']=text[:first_positive.start()]+old[:-1]+', foreign.native_decide.ax_1]'+text[first_positive.end():]
for suffix in ('rejected','valid'):
    match=next(m for m in matches if m.group(1).startswith('FiveBoundary.ExcessTwo.Generated.cert_') and m.group(1).endswith('_'+suffix))
    old=match.group(0)
    mutated=re.sub(r'\b[^,\s\[\]]*\.native_decide\.[^,\s\[\]]*','foreign.native_decide.ax_1',old)
    assert mutated!=old
    controls[suffix+'_foreign_native_replaced']=text[:match.start()]+mutated+text[match.end():]
match=next(m for m in matches if m.group(1)=='FiveBoundary.color_orbits_cover')
old=match.group(0)
mutated=re.sub(r'\b[^,\s\[\]]*\.native_decide\.[^,\s\[\]]*','foreign.native_decide.ax_1',old)
controls['s4_foreign_native_replaced']=text[:match.start()]+mutated+text[match.end():]
def info(path):
    raw=path.read_bytes()
    return {'path':str(path),'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
records={}
for name,value in controls.items():
    log=control_root/(name+'.log');log.write_text(value)
    output=control_root/(name+'.json')
    argv=['python3',str(helper),'--log',str(log),'--source',str(source),'--output',str(output)]
    run=subprocess.run(argv,text=True,capture_output=True)
    stdout=control_root/(name+'.stdout');stderr=control_root/(name+'.stderr')
    stdout.write_text(run.stdout);stderr.write_text(run.stderr)
    expected=0 if name in ('historical_baseline','extra_error_diagnostic') else 1
    records[name]={'argv':argv,'exit_code':run.returncode,'expected_exit_code':expected,'expectation_holds':run.returncode==expected,'input':info(log),'stdout':info(stdout),'stderr':info(stderr),'last_stderr_line':run.stderr.splitlines()[-1] if run.stderr else '', 'output':info(output) if output.exists() else None}
assert all(record['expectation_holds'] for record in records.values()),records
assert hashlib.sha256(helper.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==helper_sha,'helper changed during control runs'
baseline=json.loads((control_root/'historical_baseline.json').read_text())
summary={'schema':'m3-axiom-parser-helper-controls-v3','status':'PASS','scope':'HELPER CONTROLS ONLY: historical Oct05 log and synthetic corruptions; not current LC build or axioms evidence','control_root':str(control_root),'helper':info(helper),'historical_gzip':info(historical),'source':info(source),'baseline_groups':baseline['groups'],'baseline_aggregate_native_counts':baseline['aggregate_native_counts'],'baseline_declaration_count':baseline['declaration_count'],'controls':records,'limits':['Extra error diagnostic text is ignored by the helper; formal fresh Lean command must separately exit 0.','Historical Oct05 log is used only as parser input; this does not substitute for current candidate LC build or axioms evidence.','Candidate Lean source and helper were not changed by this review.'],'earlier_attempts':[{'name':'axiom-parser-helper-controls','exit_code':1,'reason':'Reviewer control harness regex escaping error before running helper.'},{'name':'axiom-parser-helper-controls-v2','exit_code':1,'reason':'Old helper incorrectly included all_certificates_valid in the 179 per-certificate valid group; fixed by root.'}]}
output=audit/'axiom-helper-controls-v3.json'
with output.open('x') as stream:json.dump(summary,stream,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2);stream.write('\n')
rows=['# M3 公理 parser helper：v3 控制','','**PASS；這是 helper 控制，並非本次 LC build／公理證據。** 原輸入為 Oct05 封存 lean_axioms.log.gz；本次 candidate 的正式 Lean 執行由 M3 root 另行處理。','', '新版 helper 正確解析原 558 項名稱及順序；positive／rejected／valid 各 179 項，native 數各為 0／1／1。所有個別 rejected／valid 的 native identity 與該 certificate 的 rejected axiom 相符；S4 cover identity 精確相符。Aggregate all_certificates_valid／all_certificates_sound 的 native 數另核對為 179／180。','', '| 控制 | exit | 結果 |','| --- | ---: | --- |']
for name,record in records.items():
    rows.append('| '+name+' | '+str(record['exit_code'])+' | '+('accepted' if record['exit_code']==0 else 'rejected')+'，符合預期 |')
rows+=['', 'Missing、duplicate、sorryAx、positive native、foreign rejected／valid native、foreign S4 native 均被拒絕。額外 error 診斷文字仍可被 helper 忽略；正式 fresh Lean 命令必須另外驗證 exit 0，不能以 parser PASS 取代。','', '完整 helper／來源／歷史輸入 hashes、控制命令、exit、stdout／stderr hashes 與暫存檔位置見 [axiom-helper-controls-v3.json](axiom-helper-controls-v3.json)。未修改 candidate Lean 或 helper。','', '早先兩次失敗全部保留：第一輪是 reviewer harness 的 regex 轉義錯誤，尚未執行 helper；第二輪發現舊 helper 把 aggregate valid 混入 per-certificate valid，root 已修正。本輪完整重核通過。','']
report=audit/'axiom-helper-controls-v3.md'
with report.open('x') as stream:stream.write('\n'.join(rows))
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','scope':summary['scope'],'control_root':str(control_root),'helper_sha256':helper_sha,'declarations':baseline['declaration_count'],'groups':baseline['groups'],'aggregate_native_counts':baseline['aggregate_native_counts'],'control_exit_codes':{k:v['exit_code'] for k,v in records.items()},'summary':info(output),'report':info(report)},sort_keys=True))

import gzip, hashlib, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
audit = Path("/home/ray/developer/ai/math/audits/2026-10-07-m3-fresh-checkout")
clone = Path("/tmp/math-m3-ba0b447")
summary = json.loads((audit/"provenance-summary.json").read_bytes())
c44 = json.loads((audit/"c44-summary.json").read_bytes())
assert c44["suite_status"] == "FAIL" and c44["failed_checks"] == 1
assert c44["finding"]["id"] == "M3-C44-INPUT-AUDIT-001"
assert c44["finding"]["diagnostic"]["difference_count"] == 2
assert {d["path"] for d in c44["finding"]["diagnostic"]["differences"]} == {"$.layers[6].es_source_present", "$.layers[6].es_source_hash_matches"}
assert c44["finding"]["candidate_source_or_saved_artifact_repaired"] is False
assert [d["source"] for d in summary["historical_review_leaf_comparison"]] == ["artifacts/c5_excess_two_e4/reductions.json", "artifacts/c5_excess_two_e5/controls.json", "artifacts/c5_excess_two_e4c/summary.json"]
branches = next(d for d in summary["comparisons"] if d["name"] == "E5_branches")
assert branches["strict_byte_status"] == "FAIL" and branches["exact_leaf_allowlist_match"]
assert branches["allowed_leaf_paths"] == ["/sources_sha256/docs/c5_excess_two_mixed_core_spokes.md"]
assert summary["new_finding"]["id"] == "M3-PROV-E5-BRANCHES"
assert all(entry["strict_byte_status"] == "FAIL" for entry in summary["comparisons"])
assert summary["strict_commands"]["e5_branches"]["exit_code"] == 1
whitespace = json.loads((audit/"whitespace-comparison.json").read_bytes())
historical = gzip.decompress((clone/"artifacts/c5_integrate_branch_review/logs/branch_whitespace.log.gz").read_bytes())
current = (audit/"logs/provenance_branch_whitespace.stdout.log").read_bytes()
assert historical == current
diagnostics = [line for line in current.decode().splitlines() if re.match(r"^(.+):(\d+): (.+)$",line)]
assert len(diagnostics) == whitespace["current_count"] == whitespace["historical_count"] == 86
assert whitespace["new_diagnostics"] == whitespace["resolved_diagnostics"] == []
for entry in whitespace["unchanged_exception_source_bytes"]:
    prior = subprocess.check_output(["git","show",summary["reference_review_sha"]+":"+entry["path"]],cwd=clone)
    candidate = subprocess.check_output(["git","show",summary["candidate_sha"]+":"+entry["path"]],cwd=clone)
    assert prior == candidate and hashlib.sha256(candidate).hexdigest() == entry["candidate"]["sha256"]
assert whitespace["full_branch_exit_code"] == 2 and whitespace["candidate_parent_diff_exit_code"] == 0
md = (audit/"c44-summary.md").read_text()
assert all(line == line.rstrip() for line in md.splitlines())
print(json.dumps({"review_status":"PASS","c44_presence_drift":"separate candidate finding; original strict FAIL retained","e5_branches":"new document-hash finding; separate from three historical FAILs","branch_whitespace":{"diagnostics":86,"raw_identical_to_historical":True,"exception_source_files":len(whitespace["unchanged_exception_source_bytes"]),"full_branch_exit_code":2,"candidate_parent_diff_exit_code":0},"c44_summary_md":{"trailing_whitespace":0,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(md.encode()).hexdigest()}}))
